assets.prompt: Create a production animation asset for a web app, using the attached four plush dots as identity reference. This is ONLY the clean furry BODY layer for a character rig. The eyes, hats and glasses will be rendered and animated separately in the app. One single character body only, centered, full body visible, almost straight-on front view, bottom resting on a horizontal baseline, absolutely transparent background. Match the reference's richly tactile short plush fibers, softly stuffed cushion volume, rounded silhouette and saturated color. Premium soft studio lighting, natural gentle self shading. No ground plane, no cast floor shadow, no text, no logos, no limbs, no extra objects. Body occupies about 80 percent of a square canvas, generous transparent margin. Do not include any eyes, face, mouth, nose, accessories, hats, glasses or sunglasses. Preserve the distinctive BODY silhouette, this is deliberately a blank rig plate, not a complete mascot. The LEFT BLUE character. A squat cyan/azure blue plush cushion blob, gently asymmetric wide low rounded dome, little rounded scallop/bulge on the right side, flattened pillowy base. Remove the black beret and both eyes completely. Color vivid saturated sky blue, as reference.
